extracted.intended_audience: writers, students of mythology and comparative religion, creative-writing practitioners interested in the Hero's Journey
extracted.subtask_description: Extracting Joseph Campbell's monomyth/story-beat elements (the Hero's Journey and the cosmogonic cycle) as structural criteria for constructing or evaluating stories. The page lists chapter and subsection headings which enumerate the canonical beats and archetypes.

rubrics_metrics.name: The monomyth
rubrics_metrics.description: Prologue heading introducing the monomyth—the overarching, universal pattern of the Hero's Journey.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: General framing: Campbell outlines the Hero's Journey as a universal motif of adventure and transformation that runs through world mythic traditions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Myth and dream
rubrics_metrics.description: Subtopic under the Prologue; links mythic structure and dream imagery.

rubrics_metrics.name: Tragedy and comedy
rubrics_metrics.description: Subtopic under the Prologue; treatment of tragic and comic modes within mythic patterns.

rubrics_metrics.name: The hero and the god
rubrics_metrics.description: Subtopic under the Prologue; relation between hero-figures and deities in myth.

rubrics_metrics.name: The world navel
rubrics_metrics.description: Subtopic under the Prologue; motif of a sacred center or 'navel' in mythic cosmology.

rubrics_metrics.name: Part I: The adventure of the hero
rubrics_metrics.description: Major section introducing the three-act structural arc of the hero: Departure, Initiation, Return.

rubrics_metrics.name: Departure
rubrics_metrics.description: Section 1 of Part I; the hero leaves the ordinary world to begin the adventure.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Contains specific beats (see listed subitems) that mark the beginning of the hero's journey.

rubrics_metrics.name: The call to adventure
rubrics_metrics.description: Beat in Departure: the inciting summons that invites the hero to adventure.

rubrics_metrics.name: Refusal of the call
rubrics_metrics.description: Beat in Departure: the hero initially resists or declines the summons.

rubrics_metrics.name: Supernatural aid
rubrics_metrics.description: Beat in Departure: a helper, mentor, or protective force appears to assist the hero.

rubrics_metrics.name: The crossing of the first threshold
rubrics_metrics.description: Beat in Departure: the hero commits to the adventure by passing into the unknown.

rubrics_metrics.name: The belly of the whale
rubrics_metrics.description: Beat in Departure: symbolic 'birth' into the adventure; separation from the old world.

rubrics_metrics.name: Initiation
rubrics_metrics.description: Section 2 of Part I; the hero undergoes trials and inner transformation.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Contains key initiation beats that mark tests, allies/enemies, and inner change.

rubrics_metrics.name: The road of trials
rubrics_metrics.description: Beat in Initiation: a series of tests and ordeals the hero must pass.

rubrics_metrics.name: The meeting with the Goddess
rubrics_metrics.description: Beat in Initiation: encounter with a powerful feminine figure representing unity or reward.

rubrics_metrics.name: Woman as the Temptress
rubrics_metrics.description: Beat in Initiation: temptation that can distract or derail the hero from the quest.

rubrics_metrics.name: Atonement with the father
rubrics_metrics.description: Beat in Initiation: reconciliation or confrontation with a paternal figure or authority.

rubrics_metrics.name: Apotheosis
rubrics_metrics.description: Beat in Initiation: a moment of elevation, understanding, or transformation.

rubrics_metrics.name: The ultimate boon
rubrics_metrics.description: Beat in Initiation: the achievement of the quest's goal or the legendary prize.

rubrics_metrics.name: Return
rubrics_metrics.description: Section 3 of Part I; the hero's journey back to the ordinary world and reintegration.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Contains beats describing difficulties and successful reintegration on return.

rubrics_metrics.name: Refusal of the return
rubrics_metrics.description: Beat in Return: after achieving the boon, the hero may resist returning to the ordinary world.

rubrics_metrics.name: The magic flight
rubrics_metrics.description: Beat in Return: a perilous flight back with the boon, often requiring supernatural assistance.

rubrics_metrics.name: Rescue from without
rubrics_metrics.description: Beat in Return: the hero may need outside help to return or reintegrate.

rubrics_metrics.name: The crossing of the return threshold
rubrics_metrics.description: Beat in Return: the moment of re-entry into ordinary life and reconciling experience with society.

rubrics_metrics.name: Master of the Two Worlds
rubrics_metrics.description: Beat in Return: the hero attains balance between inner/spiritual and outer/material worlds.

rubrics_metrics.name: Freedom to live
rubrics_metrics.description: Beat in Return: the hero is released from fear of death and can live freely.

rubrics_metrics.name: The keys
rubrics_metrics.description: Section 4 of Part I; likely summarizing practical principles or 'keys' to the monomyth (listed as a chapter heading).

rubrics_metrics.name: Part II: The cosmogonic cycle
rubrics_metrics.description: Major section exploring mythic patterns of world-creation, transformation, and dissolution in myth (a complementary cycle to the hero's adventure).

rubrics_metrics.name: Emanations
rubrics_metrics.description: Part II, section 1: discusses emanation motifs and stages (from psychology to metaphysics; creation myths).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Subitems listed: From psychology to metaphysics; The universal round; Out of the void--space; Within space--life; The breaking of the One into the Manifold; Folk stories of creation.

rubrics_metrics.name: From psychology to metaphysics
rubrics_metrics.description: Subtopic under Emanations; marks the movement from psychological interpretation to metaphysical meaning.

rubrics_metrics.name: The universal round
rubrics_metrics.description: Subtopic under Emanations; motif of cyclical or universal structure in cosmogony.

rubrics_metrics.name: Out of the void--space
rubrics_metrics.description: Subtopic under Emanations; creation motif of emergence from void/space.

rubrics_metrics.name: Within space--life
rubrics_metrics.description: Subtopic under Emanations; life arising within space as a cosmogonic theme.

rubrics_metrics.name: The breaking of the One into the Manifold
rubrics_metrics.description: Subtopic under Emanations; mythic motif where unity divides into multiplicity.

rubrics_metrics.name: Folk stories of creation
rubrics_metrics.description: Subtopic under Emanations; catalogue of traditional creation tales.

rubrics_metrics.name: The virgin birth
rubrics_metrics.description: Part II, section 2: motif of miraculous birth and mother-universe imagery.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Subitems listed: Mother universe; Matrix of destiny; Womb of redemption; Folk stories of virgin motherhood.

rubrics_metrics.name: Mother universe
rubrics_metrics.description: Subtopic under The virgin birth; cosmological maternal motif.

rubrics_metrics.name: Matrix of destiny
rubrics_metrics.description: Subtopic under The virgin birth; destiny arising from a womb/matrix motif.

rubrics_metrics.name: Womb of redemption
rubrics_metrics.description: Subtopic under The virgin birth; regenerative/redeeming birth motif.

rubrics_metrics.name: Folk stories of virgin motherhood
rubrics_metrics.description: Subtopic under The virgin birth; comparative examples of virgin-birth tales.

rubrics_metrics.name: Transformations of the hero
rubrics_metrics.description: Part II, section 3: survey of hero-types and their metamorphoses across mythic traditions.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Subitems listed: The primordial hero and the human; Childhood of the human hero; The hero as warrior; The hero as lover; The hero as emperor and as tyrant; The hero as world redeemer; The hero as saint; Departure of the hero.

rubrics_metrics.name: The primordial hero and the human
rubrics_metrics.description: Subtopic under Transformations: relationship between archetypal primordial hero and historical/ordinary human hero.

rubrics_metrics.name: Childhood of the human hero
rubrics_metrics.description: Subtopic under Transformations: motifs and narratives of the hero's early life.

rubrics_metrics.name: The hero as warrior
rubrics_metrics.description: Subtopic under Transformations: martial/warrior aspect of heroic identity.

rubrics_metrics.name: The hero as lover
rubrics_metrics.description: Subtopic under Transformations: eros/romantic aspect of heroic narrative.

rubrics_metrics.name: The hero as emperor and as tyrant
rubrics_metrics.description: Subtopic under Transformations: political/powerful permutations of the hero figure.

rubrics_metrics.name: The hero as world redeemer
rubrics_metrics.description: Subtopic under Transformations: salvific or messianic hero roles.

rubrics_metrics.name: The hero as saint
rubrics_metrics.description: Subtopic under Transformations: sanctified or saintlike hero figures.

rubrics_metrics.name: Departure of the hero (Part II)
rubrics_metrics.description: Subtopic under Transformations: motifs of the hero's final departure or disappearance.

rubrics_metrics.name: Dissolutions
rubrics_metrics.description: Part II, section 4: patterns of ending, decay, and dissolution in mythic cosmology.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Subitems: End of the Microcosm; End of the Macrocosm.

rubrics_metrics.name: End of the Microcosm
rubrics_metrics.description: Subtopic under Dissolutions: collapse or ending at the small-scale (individual/worldlet) level.

rubrics_metrics.name: End of the Macrocosm
rubrics_metrics.description: Subtopic under Dissolutions: cosmic-scale dissolution or eschatological ending.

rubrics_metrics.name: Epilogue: Myth and society
rubrics_metrics.description: Epilogue section addressing the social function of myth and the contemporary place of the hero.

rubrics_metrics.name: The shapeshifter
rubrics_metrics.description: Epilogue subtopic: the figure who changes form or role in myth and its narrative function.

rubrics_metrics.name: The function of myth, cult and meditation
rubrics_metrics.description: Epilogue subtopic: how myth, ritual, and contemplative practice function in society and psyche.

rubrics_metrics.name: The hero today
rubrics_metrics.description: Epilogue subtopic: discussion of the contemporary relevance and forms of the hero archetype.
